fieldNotes.truckGate: Both the NW driveway (signalized junction with Blue Hills Ave) and the SE driveway are wide-open uncontrolled entrances - no barrier arm, sliding gate, or pinch-point checkpoint visible in 2025-07 Street View or satellite imagery.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth at either entrance. Small utility cabinet at the NW driveway mouth, not a staffed booth.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Two separate driveways onto Blue Hills Avenue (NW and SE), each connecting to a perimeter loop road; trucks can use either.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long approach from either road junction to the dock circulation road - room for 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~25-40 dock doors estimated: a long bank along the north face with trailers backed in, plus additional dock positions on the SE side. Counted from zoom-20 imagery; band 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Dedicated drop yard at the NW corner with rows of parked trailers (no tractors); 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity on two distinct building faces - long north-face dock bank and a separate SE-side dock cluster.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Bloomfield CT industrial park on the northern edge of the Hartford metro; large warehouses adjacent but woodland and open land around - edge-of-town industrial, classified Rural per rubric tiebreak.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~33 acres derived from perimeter box (~415m N-S x ~360m E-W of fenced property).
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property; solar array occupies land to the east where a spur might otherwise run.
